releaseNotes.zh: 新增采购入库、清冰箱选菜和健身备餐三个工作流，改进任务恢复、操作记录与撤销，支持自愿提交诊断反馈。保留柔和界面。需要邀请码；请覆盖安装保留本地数据。
releaseNotes.en: Three workflows for groceries, fridge ingredients and fitness meals, with task recovery, clearer action records and voluntary diagnostic feedback. Keeps the soft UI. Invite required; install over the existing app to keep local data.
